body:
I'm wondering if this is an issue.

I have auto-session working as a session manager, and I use it through mini.starter.
I don't think this has to do with what session manager is in use tho. 

I think if you're using mini.starter and you do the following with a session manager:
1. Open nvim
2. Open one or two other files
3. Create a source file in your repo called Starter
4. Save your session

When you go to restore this session in mini.starter I get this:

```
Error detected while processing CursorMoved Autocommands for "<buffer=1>":                              
Error executing lua callback: ...nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/starter.lua:1251: Cursor p
osition outside buffer                                                                                  
stack traceback:                                                                                        
        [C]: in function 'nvim_win_set_cursor'                                                          
        ...nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/starter.lua:1251: in function 'position_cursor_o
n_current_item'                                                                                         
        ...nvim/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/starter.lua:1319: in function <...nvim/site/pack
/deps/start/mini.nvim/lua/mini/starter.lua:1319>    
``` 

I think mini.starter may get confused in this case. Would it make more sense to use a buffer name which starts with ```starter:///``` to ensure the starter buffer does not overlap with any files?
